title: Complete proof of Minimizing Lagrange Interpolation Basis Polynomial Integrals

problemStatement.plain: Formal mathematical investigation: Complete proof of Minimizing Lagrange Interpolation Basis Polynomial Integrals.

knowledge.progressSummary: SURVEYED: 2 sorries in Erdos1131Problem.lean at lines 795 (Lagrange interpolation exactness) and 842 (DCT Parseval bilinear expansion). Both require significant Mathlib API work. Good Aristotle candidates if companion file prepared.
builtItems: Survey: documented 2 sorry targets with required Mathlib lemmas
insights: Sorry at line 795: needs Lagrange interpolation exactness — for degree < n polynomial and n distinct nodes, ∑p(x_k)·l_k(x) = p(x). Likely in Mathlib as Lagrange.interpolate_poly_eq_self or similar
Sorry at line 842: needs bilinear expansion with DCT orthogonality — expand ∑l_k² as trace of W_{km} matrix where W_{kk}=n, W_{km}=0. This is a summation identity, not standard Mathlib
Both sorries are in private lemmas used in the proof chain: chebyshev_interp (L795) and chebyshev_sq_expansion (L842)
File has 1 axiom (erdos_1131_conjecture at L972) — this is the main open conjecture, not provable
